record.question: From which place did Mahatma Gandhi begin the Salt March?
record.explanation: Answer A: Ahmedabad. The Salt March began at Sabarmati Ashram near Ahmedabad. Reference: https://www.gandhiheritageportal.org/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
